Product.label: Produits (E-commerce)
Product.schema: CREATE TABLE products (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), slug VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, price DECIMAL(10,2), stock INT DEFAULT 0, image VARCHAR(255), category_id INT NULL, active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

Order.label: Commandes (E-commerce)
Order.schema: CREATE TABLE orders (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, order_number VARCHAR(64), user_id INT NULL, customer_name VARCHAR(255), customer_email VARCHAR(255), customer_address TEXT, customer_phone VARCHAR(64), total DECIMAL(10,2), total_price DECIMAL(10,2), status VARCHAR(50), payment_method VARCHAR(50), items TEXT, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

OrderItem.label: Lignes de commande (E-commerce)
OrderItem.schema: CREATE TABLE order_items (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT, product_id INT, product_name VARCHAR(255), quantity INT DEFAULT 1, price DECIMAL(10,2))

EcommerceCategory.label: Catégories (E-commerce)
EcommerceCategory.schema: CREATE TABLE ecommerce_categories (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), slug VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, parent_id INT NULL)
